Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Trainer! Before you set off, there is somebody you need to meet.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, 11 Oct, Anthony): the Head Coach introduces Wastl and says goodbye, the first time you open the Adventure board in your own game (Guide.csv wastl_intro).

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Servus! Wastl, captain of the Adventure Team. I have walked every path from the Marsh to the mountains with a ball at my feet.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Out there it is not football as we play it at home. Wastl knows the wild. Listen to him and he will teach you the basics.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Whenever something new happens I stop us and say what it means. Only the first time, I promise.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: And this is where I say goodbye. Beuterdorf needs me, and those creatures will not wait.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The club is yours now, Trainer. Make the town proud. Servus!

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Right then. Pick a scroll off the board and let us go!

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Off we go, Trainer! Four of ours run out with the ball, and they pass it about as they go.
Notes: DRAFT lines (round AN, 10-11 Oct): WASTL, the captain of the Adventure Team, explains each Adventure moment the first time it happens in your own game (Anthony: not the Head Coach). Rewrite them here. Which moment plays which scene is MatchTalk.csv rows coach_adv_* (Mode adventure;intro_adventure, Once true). His faces are StoryArt.csv rows wastl.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Remember: nothing you pick up out here is yours until you carry it home. Escape stops the run if you need a breather.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Something lying about! Whoever is closest peels off and grabs it. It goes in the haul, top right.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Hold up, something blocks the way. The party forms up and that means a fight.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: That is the boss of this bounty. Put it down and you can claim the bounty and carry everything home.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: First pick who you go after. Hover over an enemy and it tells you its stamina, its icons and its abilities. Click to pick it.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: The whole move goes into that one, so pick the one that hurts you most, or the one nearly down.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Now one player from each Tier, Tier I first and Tier IV last. They pass the ball up the line and the last one shoots.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Whoever plays sits out until everybody else in that Tier has had a turn too. Hover a card to see what it brings.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: See the icons along the top? That is the pile. Every player you send adds their icons to it.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Hover a card and the icons it would add blink on the bar. Collect enough of one kind and it pays out.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: There! Enough of one icon and it pays out. Some add to the shot, some heal, some hit straight away.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: The pile keeps building until every Tier has had its turn. Then it empties and you start again.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: All four are in. Their powers and the pile go into the one you picked. Then everything still standing hits back.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Watch them! Some enemies get angrier with every pass you make, and hit harder this round.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Got one! When an enemy runs out of stamina it is gone. Put them all down and the way is clear.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Now their turn. Every enemy still standing hits one of ours and takes stamina off them.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: They have icons too, and the same rules. Enough of one kind and their last hit is a big one.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Down! Out of stamina means out for the rest of the run, and longer in bed back home.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: If a whole Tier has nobody left, they walk straight through it and hit twice as hard. Keep all four standing.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: A Tier with nobody in it! Everything they do this round lands twice.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Everybody has had a turn, so the pile empties. Your players are all back to pick from.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: The fight is won. Two lads from the club carry off whoever went down. They are out for the rest of the run.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Cleared! Now the big question: further in, or home?

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Further in there is more to carry. Go home now and you keep all of it. If everybody falls, you lose the lot.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Everybody down. Everything you were carrying stays out there.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Next time, go home while you still can. Fleeing keeps most of it.

Speaker: Wastl
Text: Your bag. The things you can use here light up, and using one does not cost a turn.
